description: This file defines the LakeFormationClient class that serves as a client interface to interact with the AWS Lake Formation service. It declares a series of methods for various AWS Lake Formation operations, both synchronous and asynchronous, enabling interaction with AWS Lake Formation's API endpoints.

classes.name: LakeFormationClient
classes.description: A client class used to interact with AWS Lake Formation, providing methods to perform various operations related to data lakes, tags, permissions, transactions, and resource management.

methods.name: addLFTagsToResource
methods.description: Adds Lake Formation tags to a specified resource.

methods.name: assumeDecoratedRoleWithSAML
methods.description: Assumes a role with SAML authentication for Lake Formation.

methods.name: batchGrantPermissions
methods.description: Batch grants permissions to Lake Formation resources.

methods.name: batchRevokePermissions
methods.description: Batch revokes permissions from Lake Formation resources.

methods.name: createLFTag
methods.description: Creates a new Lake Formation tag.

methods.name: createLakeFormationIdentityCenterConfiguration
methods.description: Creates configuration for Lake Formation Identity Center.

methods.name: createLakeFormationOptIn
methods.description: Creates an opt-in configuration for Lake Formation.

methods.name: deleteLakeFormationIdentityCenterConfiguration
methods.description: Deletes the Lake Formation Identity Center configuration.

methods.name: deleteLakeFormationOptIn
methods.description: Deletes a Lake Formation opt-in configuration.

methods.name: deregisterResource
methods.description: Deregisters a resource from Lake Formation.

methods.name: describeLakeFormationIdentityCenterConfiguration
methods.description: Describes the Lake Formation Identity Center configuration.

methods.name: describeResource
methods.description: Provides details about a specific resource.

methods.name: extendTransaction
methods.description: Extends the duration of a transaction.

methods.name: getDataLakePrincipal
methods.description: Gets information about a data lake principal.

methods.name: getEffectivePermissionsForPath
methods.description: Gets effective permissions for a specified path.

methods.name: getLFTag
methods.description: Retrieves details of a Lake Formation tag.

methods.name: getQueryState
methods.description: Gets the state of a query.

methods.name: getResourceLFTags
methods.description: Gets tags associated with a resource.

methods.name: getTemporaryGluePartitionCredentials
methods.description: Gets temporary credentials for Glue partition.

methods.name: getTemporaryGlueTableCredentials
methods.description: Gets temporary credentials for Glue table.

methods.name: getWorkUnitResults
methods.description: Retrieves results for a work unit.

methods.name: listResources
methods.description: Lists resources registered with Lake Formation.

methods.name: registerResource
methods.description: Registers a new resource with Lake Formation.

methods.name: updateTableStorageOptimizer
methods.description: Updates storage optimizer configuration for a table.
